overview.description: The T. Rowe Price U.S. Equity Research ETF (TSPA) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TSPA is an actively-managed, non-transparent fund that seeks long-term capital growth by investing in US-listed companies selected and weighted similar to the S&P 500 Index The fund utilizes the T TSPA was launched on Jun 8, 2021 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
